【上海市大同初级中学的吴老师】嗨,大家!我是来自上海市大同初级中学的吴老师。请把你的学生书,工作室和笔记准备好。你还记得凌凌12和明的旅行计划吗?让我们评论凌凌12和明的旅行计划。他们去哪里?凌凌12去北京,明去湖南、昆明和丽江。对,他们去哪里?凌凌12去飞机,明去飞机、高速船和巴士。好,他们去哪里?凌凌12去北京,巴士。凌凌12去飞机,巴士。旅行計劃,好的。既然這兩篇文章是關於旅行計劃,必須要有些詞語關於未來計劃。請轉到88條,並列明那些詞語。讓我們一起看看答案。你們都找到了嗎?這裡有些關於未來計劃的詞語圖案。例如,be going to,somebody's plan for something is,and plan to,try to keep them in mind.現在,請說一下旅行計劃和旅行計劃。這次,請記得告訴我們要去哪裡,要怎麼旅行,要怎麼做。並用be going to,somebody's plan for is,or plan to,來描述計劃。準備好了嗎?我會努力的,是嗎?好,我會努力的。我很喜歡你。She plans to get around the city by bus, visit some historical places, and do a bicycle tour of the Hutongs.Thank you.Yoyo, what do you think of Mary's answer?I think it's great because Mary talked about the key information of Lingling12's travel plan, and she used be going to and plan to to describe the plan.I agree with you.Then, how about Ming's travel plan?Peter, have a try.First, Ming is going to fly to Hunan and hike in Zhangjiajie National Forest Park.After that, he plans to take a high-speed train to Kunming, and then take a bus to Lijiang for Yulong Snow Mountain.Finally, he plans to fly back home.Sammy, what do you think of Peter's work?I think it's fantastic.Peter mentioned the places, ways of traveling, and activities in Ming's travel plan.And he also used plan to and be going to to describe the plan.Agreed.Both of you did a good job.Let's think further about Lingling12's and Ming's travel plans.Please think about the following questions.In what ways can Lingling12 get to know Beijing's history?JasonBy visiting some historical places and doing a bicycle tour of the Hutong.Right.They are both good activities for us to get to know the history of a city.Then, what does at the top of my list mean in Ming's post?MaryIt means the beautiful Zhangjiajie National Forest Park is the place he wants to visit most.Then, what fun experiences are they probably going to have during their trips?YoyoLingling12 is probably going to enjoy visiting the historical places in Beijing and visiting the Hutongs by bicycle.Ming is probably going to get close to nature and enjoy hiking in the mountains.Thanks.Through your answer, I can tell Lingling12 and Ming are going to enjoy themselves during the trip.Well done.In Ming's post, he used at the top of my list to show his excitement for the trip.Now, please find out more ways in Lingling12 and Ming's post and underline them.Thank you for watching.Let's check together.Have you found them all?Good.Please pay attention to the exclamation mark.It can also show excitement.Don't miss it.And with one's own eyes means 亲眼所见Now, I believe you know Lingling12 and Ming's travel plans very well.But have you noticed what is special about each of the travel plans?Please think about the question.What's special about their trip?Peter and Sammy have a try.Riding a bicycle in the Hutongs is special in Lingling12's trip.Hiking in Zhangjiajie National Forest Park is special in Ming's trip.Thanks for sharing.That sounds really fun.What language did they use to communicate with readers?Youyou, what's your idea?I think Lingling12 tried to talk to the readers by using you know what.She used be going to to talk about the future plan.And she showed her excitement by using it's going to be fun.Beijing, here I come.I think Ming used Lingling words like after that, then in the travel plan.To talk about the future plan, he also used some sentence patterns like my plan for, be going to, plan to, and I can't wait to start my trip to show his excitement.Indeed, in a post about the travel plan, we need to talk to the readers and use some sentence patterns to talk about the future plan and show our excitement.It's also good to use some Lingling words to show the plan in a proper way.Now Lu Yao is sharing her travel plan with Wang Yiming.It's your turn to rewrite Lu Yao's words into a post in forum.It's task one in your worksheet.Let's share.Tony, have a try.You know what?I'm going to visit Sichuan with my parents this winter.We plan to take the high-speed train there.There are so many delicious local snacks to eat, such as hot pot and noodles.We are also going to see the lovely pandas there.It's going to be fun.Sichuan, here I come.Thank you, Tony.Yoyo, what do you think of Tony's work?I think it's great.He used you know what to talk to readers and be going to and plan to to talk about the future plan.And he also showed his excitement by using it's going to be fun.Wonderful.I quite agree with you.Both of you did a great job.Homework for today.One, finish exercise C on pages 78 to 79, workbook 6A.Two, write a post on your travel plan for this winter vacation in a few sentences.This is the end of the class.
